input_summary.question:
按账单国家统计USA的发票总额同比增长率是多少？
用户已确认的当前条件（替代被改动的旧条件，其余条件保留）：{"task_type": "growth", "metric": "invoice_revenue", "time_scope": {"current": {"start": "2024-01-01", "end": "2025-01-01", "label": "2024年", "grain": "year"}, "base": {"start": "2023-01-01", "end": "2024-01-01", "derived_from": "explicit current period and yoy"}}, "comparison": {"type": "yoy"}, "numerator": null, "denominator": null, "rank_object": null, "top_n": null, "order": null, "region_scope": "invoice.billing_country", "filters": [{"column": "invoice.billing_country", "operator": "=", "value": "USA", "mention_id": "mention-1", "method": "exact", "evidence_ref": "v-ab7ca55351c9f4bae96b", "source": "verified_value_index", "scope_evidence": "explicit_user_country_scope"}]}

output_summary.sql:
WITH revenue_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN "invoice_date" >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
       AND "invoice_date" < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' THEN 'current'
      WHEN "invoice_date" >= TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00'
       AND "invoice_date" < TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' THEN 'base'
    END AS period,
    SUM("total") AS revenue
  FROM "public"."invoice"
  WHERE "billing_country" = 'USA'
    AND "invoice_date" >= TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND "invoice_date" < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  cur.revenue AS current_revenue,
  base.revenue AS base_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN base.revenue IS NULL OR base.revenue = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (cur.revenue - base.revenue) / base.revenue
  END AS yoy_growth_rate
FROM (SELECT revenue FROM revenue_by_period WHERE period = 'current') AS cur
CROSS JOIN (SELECT revenue FROM revenue_by_period WHERE period = 'base') AS base
